concept: One made-up logo mark, a ring and a stem, in two colours only: electric violet and bone. Solid, with a selection box the shape of the Story frame on the notch where the ring meets the stem. Then exactly that patch as a small picture stores it: nine by sixteen pixels, the curve gone to a staircase. Then the same mark as the path a vector file stores, two anchor points and their handles on a symmetrical arch. Every line is counterchanged: bone where it crosses violet, violet where it crosses bone.
